description: §6.8.4 rule 3: a cycle in the static `reset-on=` graph — `a` resets on `b`, `b` resets on `a` — is E-RESET-ON-CYCLE.
rationale: §6.8.4 rule 3: "The reset-on edges (entry → reset cell) form a graph the compiler builds at compile time. A cycle — including a cell listing itself — is **E-RESET-ON-CYCLE**, naming the cells on the cycle." ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S447 "3b: `reset-on=` IS allowed on engine cells, checked against `rule=`" — "the new rec for engine reset, yes."
